title: agent-ssh wsl transport normalized registry
description: wsl transport extension for agent-ssh's normalized registry. Reaches a Windows machine's OWN WSL sshd through the wsl.exe interop stdio pipe (GSA-safe) rather than a TCP ProxyJump. Adds the `distro` field consumed by the proxy_command template's {distro} placeholder. There is no `hostname` (the interop pipe is local, not a TCP endpoint).

name.description: SSH alias for the WSL target, e.g. '<machine>-wsl'.

distro.description: WSL distro name passed to `wsl.exe -d`, e.g. 'Ubuntu'.

identity_file.description: Client key whose public half is in the WSL user's authorized_keys.
